page.layout: One column of text on the printed page, with the page number at upper left and the running head centred above it. The catchword "Capio," stands at lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Urgeo, ich tringe/ich nötige/ursi absq; supino.
Jubeo, ich heisse/ich befehle/jussi, jussum.
Video, ich sehe/vidi, visum.
Vieo, ich binde/ich biege/vievi[?], vietum.
Voveo, ich gelobe/ich thue ein gelübd/ vovi, votum.

p.i: Recita Verba sicut Lego conjuganda, quæ perfe-cta & supina variant.

main_text.l: Agnosco, ich erkenne widerumb/ agnovi, agnitum.
Abdo, ich verberge/ ich thue hinweg / abdidi, abditum.
Abscondo, ich verberge/abscondi vel abscondidi, absconditum.
Accumbo, ich sitze zu tisch / accubui, accubitum, Sic reliqua à Cubo,m habentia.
Adolesco, ich wachse auff/ ich werde groß/ adolevi, adultum.
Accendo, ich zünde an/ accendi, accensum.
Ascendo, ich steige auff/ ich gehe hinauff/ ascendi, ascensum.
Affligo, ich werffe zu boden/ ich plage/ afflixi, afflictum.
Ago, ich thue/ich handele/ egi, actum. (ctum.
Alo, ich ernehre/ich erhalte/alui, alitum & altum.
Adimo, ich nimme hinweg / ich entledige/ ademi, ademptum.
Accino, ich singe zu/ accinui, accentum. (assertū.
Assero, ich sage für gewiß/ich bestätige/ asserui.
Accerso, ich fodere herzu / ich beruffe / accersivi, accersitum.
Arcesso, ich verklage/berüffe/ arcessivi, arcessitum.
Aspicio, ich sehe an/aspexi, aspectum.
Arguo, ich zeige an/ich straffe/argui, argutum.
Bibo, ich trincke/bibi, bibitum.
Cano, ich singe/ich spiele/cecini, cantum.
Cado, ich falle/cecidi, casum.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "vievi" in the Vieo entry is printed as "viev", and the reading "vievi" is uncertain. The word "perfecta" is split across the line as "perfe-" / "cta" in the italic rubric. The "(ctum." after the Ago entry and the "(assertū." after the Accino entry are printed in parentheses at the right of the line and are kept as they stand. Black letter appears in some German words; they are set in the same type as the rest of the line and are transcribed as roman. Otherwise the page is clear.
